_doc: Hand-curated list of canon's most iconic moments — single-panel beats, declarations, deaths, victories that fans cite forever. Each entry: chapter, title, the line/moment, why iconic.

moments.title: Shanks gives Luffy the Strawhat
moments.summary: 'Bring it back to me, when you've become a great pirate.' The promise that frames the entire series.

moments.title: I'm gonna be the Pirate King!
moments.summary: Luffy's first declaration — the line that defines the journey.

moments.title: Crew enters the Grand Line — Reverse Mountain
moments.summary: Foursome rounds Reverse Mountain, sees Laboon. The Grand Line begins.

moments.title: Vivi's farewell raised hand
moments.summary: The crew lifts the X-marked arms one last time at Alabasta. Vivi is no longer crew, but always crew.

moments.title: Are you a god?
moments.summary: Luffy to Enel, post-defeat. The most quoted line in the series.

moments.title: The Bell of Shandora rings
moments.summary: Enel defeated. The 400-year-old bell of Shandora rings out — Roger heard it once before.

moments.title: I want to live!
moments.summary: Robin's cry. The Strawhats burn the World Government flag. The Buster Call comes for Enies Lobby.

rungs.summary: Robin's cry. The Strawhats burn the World Government flag.
Robin's cry. The Strawhats burn the World Government flag. The Buster Call comes for Enies Lobby.

moments.title: Going Merry's farewell
moments.summary: The crew burns the Merry. The Klabautermann thanks them for sailing her. The most emotionally devastating moment in the series.

moments.title: Brook joins the crew
moments.summary: The musician finally joins. Bink's Sake plays one last time on the deck of Thriller Bark.

moments.title: Hancock's Mero Mero defeats the Pacifista
moments.summary: Hancock loves Luffy and shows it.

moments.title: Ace dies in Luffy's arms
moments.summary: Akainu's magma fist through Ace's chest. 'Thank you for loving me.' Luffy's worst hour.

moments.title: One Piece is real!
moments.summary: Whitebeard's last words to the world. 'Someone WILL find One Piece. The world will be turned upside down.' Then he stands and dies on his feet.

moments.title: 3D2Y — Luffy's message to the crew
moments.summary: The 2-year skip is set in motion. The crew agrees by reading the codes Luffy left in the Sabaody newspaper.

moments.title: Strawhats reach the New World
moments.summary: Fishman Island concludes. The crew enters the second half of the Grand Line. The world's most dangerous era begins.

moments.title: Sabo eats the Mera Mera no Mi
moments.summary: Ace's flame-flame fruit lives on through his sworn brother. Doflamingo unsettled.

moments.title: King Punch — Doflamingo defeated
moments.summary: Gear Fourth + Conqueror's Haki. The largest single-chapter splash page of the post-timeskip era.

moments.title: Katakuri shows his face
moments.summary: Luffy refuses to attack while Katakuri's mochi-shark mouth is exposed. Future Sight unlocked.

moments.title: Imu sits the Empty Throne
moments.summary: The hidden ruler of the World Government revealed. Bows from the Five Elders. Photographs viewed and marked for erasure.

moments.title: Roger laughs at Laugh Tale
moments.summary: The Roger Pirates reach the final island and read the Rio Poneglyph. Roger laughs. He says he was 'born too early'. He decides to die.

moments.title: Strawhat & Heart & Kid Alliance vs Yonko
moments.summary: Three Worst Generation captains face Big Mom and Kaidou simultaneously. Onigashima rooftop. The page where Luffy declares 'I'm Going To Be Pirate King.'

moments.title: Conqueror's Coating revealed — Luffy clashes Kaidou
moments.summary: Black-and-red lightning. The strongest creature meets his match.

moments.title: Kaidou defeated
moments.summary: Bajrang Gun. Wano free. The strongest creature falls.

moments.title: Hito Hito no Mi, Model: Nika revealed
moments.summary: The Devil Fruit was always Nika. The Gomu Gomu name was a 800-year lie. Luffy laughs and the world bends to it. Gear 5 awakens.

moments.title: Buggy becomes Yonko
moments.summary: Cross Guild reshapes the world's political balance. Mihawk + Crocodile + Buggy as figurehead. Reverse-bounty system on the Marines.

moments.title: Cobra dies — Imu revealed publicly
moments.summary: Sabo's account: Cobra confronts the Five Elders, asks the meaning of D., Imu kills him. The truth begins to leak through Morgans's broadcasts.

moments.title: Vegapunk's broadcast
moments.summary: Vegapunk Stella's posthumous global address. The truth of the Void Century begins to leak. The world shakes.

moments.title: Loki revealed on Elbaph
moments.summary: Final Saga's Elbaph chapter — the imprisoned giant Loki seen for the first time. Sun God / Joy Boy connections deepen.
